name: better-compaction
description: Compaction that waits for the model's turn to end, and summarizes at its own effort level.

deferCompaction.title: Wait for the turn to end before compacting
deferCompaction.description: On: auto-compaction never interrupts the model mid-turn; it runs as soon as the turn ends. Off: Claude Code's default (compacts mid-turn).

deferUnderPercent.title: Stop waiting past this context %
deferUnderPercent.description: Once the context is this full (% of the model's context window), compaction runs mid-turn anyway, so the turn can't hit a prompt-too-long error. 100 never stops waiting.

compactionEffort.title: Compaction effort
compactionEffort.description: Effort level the summarizer runs at. The model stays the same, so the prompt cache is kept. 'inherit' uses the conversation's effort.
